mapper.sql: user_reward_id, user_id, reward_policy_id, stamp_id, pilgrimage_id, status, audit_score, audit_detail, granted_at, claimed_at, resolved_at, resolved_by

SELECT ur.user_reward_id, ur.user_id, u.nickname, ur.reward_policy_id, rp.name AS reward_name, rp.reward_type, ur.status, ur.needs_review, ur.stamp_id, ur.pilgrimage_id, c.name AS course_name, ur.granted_at AS earned_at, ur.claimed_at FROM user_reward ur JOIN users u ON u.user_id = ur.user_id JOIN reward_policy rp ON rp.reward_policy_id = ur.reward_policy_id LEFT JOIN pilgrimage p ON p.pilgrimage_id = ur.pilgrimage_id LEFT JOIN course c ON c.course_id = p.course_id
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO user_reward (user_id, reward_policy_id, stamp_id, pilgrimage_id, status, granted_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{rewardPolicyId}, #{stampId}, #{pilgrimageId}, 'GRANTED', NOW())
mapper.select: WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ur.granted_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE user_reward SET status = #{status}, audit_score = #{auditScore}, audit_detail = #{auditDetail}, claimed_at = NOW(), resolved_at = NULL, resolved_by = NULL WHERE user_reward_id = #{userRewardId} AND status IN ('GRANTED', 'REJECTED')

UPDATE user_reward SET status = #{status}, needs_review = 0, resolved_at = NOW(), resolved_by = #{resolvedBy}, tracking_no = #{trackingNo} WHERE user_reward_id = #{userRewardId} AND status IN ('CLAIMED', 'UNDER_REVIEW')
mapper.select: SELECT ur.user_reward_id, ur.user_id, u.nickname, rp.name AS reward_name, rp.reward_type, ur.status, ur.needs_review, c.name AS course_name, ur.granted_at AS earned_at, ur.claimed_at, ur.tracking_no, rc.recipient_name, rc.phone, rc.address, rc.memo FROM user_reward ur JOIN users u ON u.user_id = ur.user_id JOIN reward_policy rp ON rp.reward_policy_id = ur.reward_policy_id LEFT JOIN pilgrimage p ON p.pilgrimage_id = ur.pilgrimage_id LEFT JOIN course c ON c.course_id = p.course_id LEFT JOIN reward_claim rc ON rc.user_reward_id = ur.user_reward_id WHERE ur.status IN ('CLAIMED', 'UNDER_REVIEW') OR ur.needs_review = 1 ORDER BY ur.needs_review DESC, ur.claimed_at
mapper.update: UPDATE user_reward SET status = 'REVOKED' WHERE pilgrimage_id = #{pilgrimageId} AND status = 'GRANTED'
UPDATE user_reward SET needs_review = 1 WHERE pilgrimage_id = #{pilgrimageId} AND status IN ('CLAIMED', 'UNDER_REVIEW', 'PAID')
